description: Decouple Nansen flow-intelligence API from base-trader pipeline. The scanner.py call has been burning ~1,000 dead credits/day returning all zeros due to field name mismatches. Build a standalone fetcher with time-series cache so the pipeline never calls Nansen directly.
qualityChecks: flow_intelligence_cache.json contains time-series snapshots after seed run
scanner.py returns non-zero netflow values (not all zeros)
Credit usage: ~100 credits/day for daily fetch
Pipeline runs without calling Nansen API directly
Telegram summary sent after each fetch run

userStories.title: Write fetch_nansen_flow.py — standalone fetcher with throttle and budget guard
userStories.desired_behavior: Standalone Python script, runnable via cron or direct call. Reads tracked tokens from data/sm_holdings_cache.json (fallback to config/watchlist.json). Per token: throttle check → Nansen POST /api/v1/tgm/flow-intelligence → parse segment-keyed response → append snapshot to flow_intelligence_cache.json time series → prune snapshots >30 days. Includes credit budget guard (check daily budget before making any calls) and Telegram summary of tokens updated, credits spent, errors.
userStories.preserve: All existing functions in scanner.py, signal_filter.py, and run_pipeline.py.
acceptance_criteria: python3 scripts/fetch_nansen_flow.py runs and exits 0 with no errors
Updates data/flow_intelligence_cache.json with new snapshots for each token
Skips tokens fetched within the last hour (throttle flag check)
Prunes snapshots older than 30 days on each run
Sends Telegram message: tokens updated count, credits used, any errors

userStories.title: Update scanner.py get_flow_intelligence() — swap API caller for cache reader with rolling windows
userStories.desired_behavior: Remove all Nansen API calls. get_flow_intelligence() now reads from flow_intelligence_cache.json. Computes rolling windows from time series: net_flow_1h (last 1h sum), net_flow_24h (last 24h sum), net_flow_7d, net_flow_30d. Falls back to most recent snapshot's total if <1h of history. Buy/sell pressure from most recent snapshot. Returns same flat dict shape signal_filter.py expects. On cache miss: return safe zeros + debug log.
userStories.preserve: Function signature and return dict keys must match what signal_filter.py expects. No changes to signal_filter.py or decision.py.
acceptance_criteria: scanner.py imports no nansen.ai API modules
Returns non-zero values for tokens with >=1 snapshot in cache
net_flow_24h uses rolling window, not a single raw Nansen call
Cold start: returns Nansen's own 1d value if <24h of history, then switches to rolling 7d after 7 days
signal_filter.py receives non-empty sm_netflow dict on every pipeline run

userStories.title: Manual seed run — populate initial cache (~100 credits one-time)
userStories.desired_behavior: Run fetch_nansen_flow.py once manually to seed the cache. Verify all 10 tokens have at least one snapshot with non-zero total_net_flow_usd. Confirm flow_intelligence_cache.json is valid v3 time-series format.
acceptance_criteria: All tokens in sm_holdings_cache.json have >=1 snapshot in flow_intelligence_cache.json
Each snapshot has ts, total_net_flow_usd, and segment fields populated
cache._index.tokens array matches tokens in sm_holdings_cache.json
Telegram summary received after seed run

userStories.title: Update PROJ-base-trader-improvements.md — mark SM2 (flow intelligence fix) complete
userStories.desired_behavior: Open PROJ-base-trader-improvements.md, locate item SM2 (flow intelligence), update status from IN PROGRESS or PENDING to COMPLETE. Include a brief note on what was implemented (standalone fetcher + time-series cache + rolling windows).
